name: Candy

scaling.scaled: Banded pull-ups, knee push-ups, 3 rounds. The volume dwarfs Cindy's — plan set sizes before the clock starts.
scaling.beginner: 3 rounds of 10 ring rows, 20 elevated push-ups, 30 squats. Build to the full five rounds over weeks.

origin.summary: One of the expanded Girls series: five rounds of pull-ups, push-ups, and squats at volumes that make Cindy look polite. The structure is classic early-CrossFit bodyweight attrition — no skill gate, no equipment, nowhere to hide. Part of CrossFit's original 'Girls' benchmark series — named workouts introduced by founder Greg Glassman starting in 2003, on the logic that anything that leaves you flat on your back deserves a name like a storm. They serve as repeatable fitness tests: revisit one every few months and the clock tells you whether you're fitter.

description: Five rounds of pull-ups, push-ups, and air squats at higher per-round volume than Barbara, with no prescribed rest between rounds.
source_notes: crossfit.com/faq/wod (official CrossFit FAQ, 'Explain The Workouts with Names (the Girls)?'), retrieved 2026-07-08
